meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research for design direction. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

copy.tagline: 构建、优化和美化前端界面与交互
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要开发或改进网页的用户界面和体验
copy.tagline_en: Build, optimize, and polish frontend UI and interactions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to develop or improve web user interfaces and experiences

howto.what: 当你问前端、UI、设计、性能优化等问题时，Claude 会加载专业的设计、性能、可访问性规则，并强制执行设计系统和开发工具检查，产出高质量、设计完善的前端代码。
howto.when: 当你提到“前端”、“UI”、“设计”、“样式”、“布局”、“动画”、“无障碍”、“Lighthouse”、“Core Web Vitals”等关键词，或要求“让它好看”、“像某个品牌”时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个好看的登录页面。
say.note: 会加载设计规则和参考，生成符合品味的代码。
会运行Lighthouse审计并提供优化建议。

howto.what_en: When you ask about frontend, UI, UX, design, performance, or accessibility, Claude loads professional design rules, performance guides, and accessibility checks, enforces design systems and dev tooling, and produces high-quality, well-designed frontend code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'frontend', 'UI', 'design', 'layout', 'animation', 'Lighthouse', 'accessibility', 'make it pretty', or request a brand style like 'Stripe'.

say_en.text: Design a beautiful login page for me.
say_en.note: Loads design rules and references for tasteful output.

say_en.text: Audit the performance of this React component.
say_en.note: Runs Lighthouse audit and suggests optimizations.
